text: Each of the six assignments uses the same capability headings but its own mandatory thresholds. Meeting a threshold exactly counts as satisfying it. Specialist equipment recovery or clearing assignments additionally require the relevant methods. A mission's point formula rewards only the designated rated attributes, not every capability that exceeds its minimum.

items: Protection Priority requires four people, 80 km/h mobility, 10 performance points and 10 protection points. It also needs 25 km communication and one awareness method. Equipment Recovery and Hazard Clearance have additional specialist-method minima.

text: Use the specific mission table assigned to your team, including its specialist measures.
A communications-device range estimate cannot limit the summed game total.
